critical_gaps.component: Report Document family (page frame, header block, section block, empty block, placeholder block)
critical_gaps.recommendation: BLOCKED ON ESC-1 — do not build until the escalation is answered. If approved, build as a SHARED family, not module-specific: any future exported document needs the same parts. The dashboard panels themselves (Diagram Library, the seven KPI card families, KPIs Line Charts) already exist and are reusable; what is missing is only the page that holds them.

critical_gaps.component: Excel workbook surface (sheet object, series-values table)
critical_gaps.recommendation: BLOCKED ON ESC-1, and the weakest case for Figma components in the feature — a workbook has no visual surface a person navigates. Recommended resolution is a data contract in /developer-handoff (sheet naming, column order, unit scaling per REQ-59, no-readings copy) rather than Figma components.

critical_gaps.component: Transactional email family (header, body, attachment block, footer)
critical_gaps.recommendation: BLOCKED ON ESC-1, and additionally dependent on PRD claim 6 (mail abstraction with no delivered route), which remains UNVERIFIED — if there is no delivery route the surface has no consumer. Note the library’s spacing-token model cannot be used here: transactional email is table-based and inline-styled with no CSS variables.

Add the Loading state the Button set’s own documentation already describes but which exists in none of its 108 variants. Use Icons/General/Loading in the icon slot, as that documentation specifies. Required by REQ-38 (generate once, on demand) to prevent a double-fire.

critical_gaps.component: Focus state on Button, Checkbox, Radio Button, Switch, Flat Tab, Button Tab
critical_gaps.recommendation: REQ-75 commits this module to WCAG 2.2 AA, which requires a visible focus indicator on every interactive control. All eight field families already carry State=Focused, so the library has the idiom and these six sets simply lack it. Fix in the shared components — a report-specific focus style would be wrong and invisible to every other feature.

medium_gaps.recommendation: Build as a Time variant of the existing Dropdown, with Icons/General/Clock in its Left Icon swap slot. Verified absent: zero hits for time picker / time of day / hh:mm / am-pm across every node name and text string in the file. Extending Dropdown reuses its label, hint, required/optional badges, six states and three sizes.

Build on Autocomplete rather than Dropdown — a zone list is long and wants search. REQ-31 requires the zone be stated on screen and never implicit, so it must render in the Filled state as persistent text, NOT as placeholder text, which disappears on entry.

Compose from Button + Option Menu (State=Multi Select) + Menu Option (Multi-Select). Nothing net-new. This is the single element of PRD Requirement 26 that the otherwise-verified shipped list pattern does not already provide.

One property carrying both the inside/outside-organization marking (REQ-35) and the invalid-address state (REQ-33). Build it once as a single property with distinct values, not as two competing tag states. Do NOT reuse Connectivity Statuses or Types Statuses: their vocabularies are unrelated, and forcing one would ship a taxonomy conflict into the build.

The range UI already exists in Date Picker Menus (its subtree contains "Select Date Range" and "Maximum duration: 3 months from start date"); the field that opens it is wired for a single value. Bind the field to the range menu rather than building a new period control, which would orphan the range menu.

Three variants on the existing set: an empty-report-list state with a create call to action in an omittable slot (REQ-10), an error state carrying a retry Button (REQ-14 — the error copy exists today but has no control), and a neutral never-run state for run history using Empty-States Icons "No Records" and explicitly NOT error styling (REQ-44).

low_gaps.component: Loading treatment for a pending form control
low_gaps.recommendation: REQ-24 needs coverage options visibly pending. No field family has a Loading state. Rather than add one to all seventeen, overlay the existing Skeleton Loading State from Tables Empty States on the control footprint.

low_gaps.component: Unit scaling inside the produced documents
low_gaps.recommendation: On screen this is already covered — Change Value and Change Unit are exposed TEXT properties on the KPI cards. Only the document half is outstanding, and it is subsumed by ESC-1.

notes: Every net-new gap here is held behind ESC-1 and must NOT be specced or built until that decision is taken. Three of the five critical gaps are that one escalation.

The two remaining critical gaps (FIND-1 Button loading, FIND-2 focus states) are LIBRARY defects this feature surfaced, not feature gaps. They should be fixed in the shared components and they benefit every feature.

No gap in this list was established by a keyword search. Each absence was confirmed by a census across every node name and every text string in all 14 pages, after descending into all 85 component sets.
